governance.purpose: Phase-0 engineering candidate baseline for implementation sizing, PoC benchmarking, performance testing, configuration defaults, and Phase-8/Phase-9 validation.
governance.relationship_to_task_0h1: Task 0H.1 established source evidence (auditing original documents where SOURCE_NUMERIC_TARGET = 0, and classifying Complete Spec PoC targets as engineering proposals). Task 0H.2 defines engineering candidate values, every one of which is explicitly classified as PHASE_0_ENGINEERING_PROPOSAL and PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW without claiming original source requirement or contractual SLA status.
governance.configuration_principle: Candidate values belong to distinct governance and configuration surfaces (runtime technical budgets, retention policies, observability thresholds, benchmark/load-test profiles, and tenant business policies). Benchmark values must not automatically become production runtime configuration. Hardcoding any candidate value in production business logic is strictly prohibited.

configuration_surfaces.runtime_technical_budgets: runtime technical configuration / solver profile (e.g., planner timeout, solver budget)
configuration_surfaces.benchmark_envelope_values: benchmark / load-test profiles (MUST NOT automatically become production runtime configuration or tenant business policy)
configuration_surfaces.business_customer_policy: versioned tenant / business policy where applicable

governance.retention_resolution_rule: Effective retention MUST satisfy all applicable legal/regulatory obligations, binding contractual requirements, and approved customer/tenant policies. The Phase-0 engineering default applies only where those governing requirements do not establish another value. Where multiple applicable requirements exist, no legal precedence or conflict resolution is decided in this technical document; approved compliance/policy resolution is required. An engineering default must never weaken an applicable governing requirement.

SLO-API-AVAIL-01.name: Core API Monthly Availability
SLO-API-AVAIL-01.scope: Core E-7 API/service availability. Provider-dependent external systems (IdP, Calendar, E-8, MySQL SIS) must be measured and observed separately.

measurement_method.included_operations: Synchronous HTTP/REST endpoints hosted by E-7 Core API gateway
measurement_method.excluded_operations: Scheduled maintenance windows, third-party provider downtime (IdP, Calendar, E-8, MySQL SIS), client-side network failures
measurement_method.instrumentation_source: Synthetic health check probes + edge gateway metrics
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Continuous health check probing at 30-second intervals

SLO-API-LAT-01.name: Core CRUD/API Latency
SLO-API-LAT-01.scope: Synchronous E-7 CRUD / metadata / lightweight command APIs (p95 < 500 ms preserves the frozen source-proposed PoC target; p99 <= 1000 ms proposed in Task 0H.2). Excludes LLM inference, solver execution, long-running workflow work, and external-provider latency.

measurement_method.included_operations: Direct synchronous entity CRUD, metadata reads, lightweight state updates
measurement_method.excluded_operations: AI plan generation, solver execution, workflow transitions, external sync calls
measurement_method.calculation: p95 and p99 percentile latency of server-side request processing duration
measurement_method.instrumentation_source: OpenTelemetry HTTP server spans / Prometheus histogram metrics
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Standard CRUD load profile under baseline concurrency

SLO-API-ERR-01.name: Core API Server-Side Error Rate
SLO-API-ERR-01.scope: Server-side failure outcomes (HTTP 5xx / unhandled internal errors). Excludes expected client validation failures (400), authentication/authorization rejections (401/403), and expected conflict/business-rule rejections (409/422).

measurement_method.included_operations: All core E-7 HTTP API requests
measurement_method.excluded_operations: Client-induced 4xx responses (validation, auth, business rule rejects)
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Continuous API traffic under baseline and stress validation

SLO-ASYNC-ACK-01.name: Asynchronous Job Acceptance Latency
SLO-ASYNC-ACK-01.scope: Request validation + durable acceptance/enqueue response (job ID assignment and outbox/queue persistence). Applies conceptually to AI planning jobs, solver jobs, and asynchronous orchestration jobs. Does NOT mean job completion in one second.

measurement_method.excluded_operations: Downstream job execution time, background worker processing duration
measurement_method.calculation: p95 duration from HTTP receipt to 202 Accepted response with job ID
measurement_method.instrumentation_source: HTTP server span + durable enqueue transaction duration
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Job submission burst under baseline concurrency

SLO-TI-PLAN-01.name: Task Intelligence Plan Generation Completion
SLO-TI-PLAN-01.scope: Goal normalization + approved context assembly + LLM planning + schema validation + bounded repair + deterministic graph validation + initial effort/risk processing under the Task 0H.2 first-tenant benchmark envelope. Configurable candidate budget, never hardcoded. Must be benchmarked against actual configured AI provider.

measurement_method.included_operations: End-to-end orchestration: context retrieval, prompt assembly, LLM calls, schema parse, bounded repair, graph validation
measurement_method.excluded_operations: User human review/approval time, UI rendering
measurement_method.calculation: p95 wall-clock execution duration of completed plan generation jobs
measurement_method.instrumentation_source: Task Intelligence orchestrator job execution span
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Standard 500-task plan generation under benchmark envelope

SLO-WF-RESP-01.name: Workflow Service Synchronous API Response
SLO-WF-RESP-01.scope: Workflow-facing synchronous E-7 APIs align with Core API baseline (p95 < 500 ms, p99 <= 1000 ms). No separate unsupported availability SLA for Flowable. External runtime/provider health must be observed independently.

measurement_method.included_operations: Workflow task query, claim, complete, state fetch via E-7 API
measurement_method.excluded_operations: Flowable background job execution, async timer evaluation, external webhooks
measurement_method.calculation: p95 and p99 server-side response duration
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Concurrent workflow task completions under baseline scale

SLO-SCHED-SOLVE-01.name: Scheduling Solve Completion Baseline
SLO-SCHED-SOLVE-01.scope: 95% of standard baseline scheduling jobs complete within 120 seconds under Task 0H.2 benchmark envelope. Configurable maximum budget 180 seconds. Solver may return FEASIBLE or INFEASIBLE. Normal infeasibility is NOT a performance failure. Optimality is NOT required within the budget. Budget is configurable, never hardcoded.

measurement_method.included_operations: Solver instance preparation, constraint model compilation, CP-SAT/solver search execution, solution extraction
measurement_method.excluded_operations: Pre-solve data gathering from external systems, post-solve human schedule publishing
measurement_method.calculation: Percentage of standard baseline solver jobs completing search within 120 seconds

SLO-EVENT-LAG-01.name: Event / Outbox Propagation Lag
SLO-EVENT-LAG-01.scope: Outbox-to-consumer-visible event propagation under healthy PostgreSQL + broker + consumer conditions. Internal E-7 reliability target; does NOT establish E-7 <-> E-8 production wire protocol.

measurement_method.included_operations: Time from outbox record insertion commit in PostgreSQL to consumer message acknowledgement
measurement_method.excluded_operations: Downstream consumer processing time, broker network partition periods
measurement_method.calculation: p95 and p99 duration between event occurrence timestamp and consumer receipt timestamp
measurement_method.instrumentation_source: Outbox publisher lag metrics + consumer receive telemetry
measurement_method.benchmark_scenario: Steady event publishing at 100 events/second burst

deferred_items.rationale: Live MySQL ERP/SIS query latency, network topology, concurrency profile, and BLK-01 connection validation remain unmeasured.
First production calendar provider selection (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Exchange/CalDAV) remains unresolved under decision D-EXT-02.
Production transport binding (RabbitMQ, Kafka, or HTTP webhook) and downstream multi-channel delivery SLA are owned by E-8.
Exact production Identity Provider (Keycloak, Azure AD, Okta, etc.) remains unresolved under decision D-EXT-01.
No business Recovery Time Objective target exists in available source documents.
No business Recovery Point Objective target exists in available source documents.
Storage capacity in GB/TB must be derived empirically from measured row sizes, retention policies, index overhead, and growth profiles.
Actual customer contract and institutional deployment scale profile requires business and institutional partner confirmation.

RET-CANONICAL-01.name: Canonical Operational Records
RET-CANONICAL-01.policy_override_rule: No arbitrary universal deletion duration in Phase 0. Retention is governed strictly by customer contract, institutional retention policy, and applicable law.

RET-PLAN-01.name: Plan / Task Version History
RET-PLAN-01.policy_override_rule: Configurable per tenant/policy; stricter legal/institutional compliance policies override this default.

RET-WF-01.name: Workflow Execution History
RET-WF-01.policy_override_rule: Configurable per tenant. Does not define Flowable's internal runtime cleanup implementation.

RET-SCHED-01.name: Scheduling Job / Result History
RET-SCHED-01.policy_override_rule: Applies to operational job/result history; currently active published schedule is preserved according to business policy.

RET-AUDIT-01.name: Audit Evidence
RET-AUDIT-01.policy_override_rule: Effective retention MUST satisfy all applicable legal/regulatory obligations, binding contractual requirements, and approved customer/tenant policies. The Phase-0 engineering default applies only where those governing requirements do not establish another value. Where multiple applicable requirements exist, no legal precedence or conflict resolution is decided in this technical document; approved compliance/policy resolution is required. 365 days is an engineering default fallback only; it must never be presented as legally sufficient or weaken an applicable governing requirement.

RET-OUTBOX-01.name: Published Outbox Records
RET-OUTBOX-01.policy_override_rule: Source-defined outbox retention remains UNRESOLVED in 0H.1; this 30-day proposal is a newly introduced engineering operational candidate.

RET-INBOX-01.name: Inbox / Deduplication Records
RET-INBOX-01.policy_override_rule: Must be configurable; production value must cover supported broker retry/replay window. No source requirement exists.

RET-INTEGRATION-01.name: Integration Delivery / Sync Evidence
RET-INTEGRATION-01.purpose: diagnostic metadata (sync outcome, command acceptance/rejection evidence, external mapping status, retry outcome metadata)
RET-INTEGRATION-01.policy_override_rule: Unnecessary external payloads must not be stored merely for diagnostics.

RET-LOG-01.name: Application Logs
RET-LOG-01.policy_override_rule: Logs must not intentionally contain secrets or unrestricted PII.

RET-TRACE-01.name: Distributed Traces
RET-TRACE-01.purpose: distributed span and execution path telemetry
RET-TRACE-01.policy_override_rule: Traces must be sampled and retained for short-term operational debugging.

RET-METRIC-01.name: Metrics / Aggregated Telemetry
RET-METRIC-01.purpose: operational capacity, latency, and throughput trend analysis
RET-METRIC-01.policy_override_rule: Long-term rollups may be retained longer per platform operational policy.

RET-AI-RAW-01.name: Raw AI Prompts / Raw Model Outputs
RET-AI-RAW-01.purpose: transient debugging and model quality evaluation under strict governance
RET-AI-RAW-01.policy_override_rule: Default is DO_NOT_PERSIST. Diagnostic persistence requires explicit approved policy. Candidate engineering retention under that policy is up to 30 days. Governing legal, contractual, or customer policy may require a different outcome. Persistence remains prohibited where the approved policy disallows it. Minimization, redaction, and access-control rules remain mandatory. The 30-day duration is an engineering candidate, not an unconditional universal maximum that overrides approved governing policy.

RET-AI-EVAL-01.name: Sanitized AI Evaluation Artifacts
RET-AI-EVAL-01.purpose: model drift tracking and deterministic validation regression testing
RET-AI-EVAL-01.policy_override_rule: Only sanitized, PII-free evaluation evidence is retained.

RET-SOLVER-TEMP-01.name: Solver-Internal Temporary Artifacts
RET-SOLVER-TEMP-01.purpose: in-depth solver search tree and constraint branch diagnostics
RET-SOLVER-TEMP-01.policy_override_rule: Default is NOT_PERSISTED_BY_DEFAULT. Candidate debug retention is up to 7 days, representing an engineering debug default / proposal, not a source-defined lifecycle and not an absolute policy override. Any exception requires approved retention/debug policy. Source-defined solver temporary lifecycle remains unresolved per frozen Task 0H.1 evidence.

RET-PII-01.name: Personal / Sensitive Data
RET-PII-01.policy_override_rule: No universal number. Task Intelligence aggregate-only restrictions remain intact (students and student_session rows in MySQL SIS are AGGREGATE_ONLY; no raw individual rows are model-visible).

governance.purpose: Implementation sizing, synthetic benchmark generation, load-test planning, and capacity planning. NOT a prediction of actual customer load.

levels.BASELINE: Expected nominal operational envelope for first institutional deployment sizing.
levels.STRESS_VALIDATION: Test headroom envelope (2x-2.5x multiplier) for pre-pilot stability and bottleneck detection, not a customer commitment.

governance.benchmark_role: The benchmark envelope exists only for implementation sizing, synthetic/load-test planning, bottleneck discovery, and capacity validation. It is NOT an actual production workload, NOT a customer commitment, and NOT a solver/API capability guarantee.
governance.configuration_assignment: Benchmark scale values belong to benchmark/load-test profiles; they MUST NOT automatically become production runtime configuration or tenant business policy.

SCALE-USERS-01.notes: The Task 0H.2 benchmark envelope does not assume students as direct E-7 users. Actual production user classes and counts remain subject to business confirmation.

SCALE-RESOURCE-01.notes: Canonical/approved references or aggregate context. Individual student rows are not model-visible.

SCALE-WF-01.notes: State stored in Flowable database; not all workflows execute simultaneously.

SCALE-SCHED-01.notes: Benchmark envelope values, not solver capability guarantees.

SCALE-INTEGRATION-01.notes: Internal contract/load-test values only; not production provider limits.

SCALE-USERS-01.notes: Stress headroom validation. The benchmark envelope does not assume students as direct E-7 users. Actual production user classes and counts remain subject to business confirmation.

SCALE-RESOURCE-01.notes: Stress headroom. Individual student rows are not model-visible.

SCALE-SCHED-01.notes: Solver stress benchmark envelope; not a capability guarantee.

SCALE-STORAGE-01.principle: Storage capacity sizing must be derived from actual row/document sizes, retention policy, index overhead, audit/event volume, and growth measurement. Storage capacity is NOT derived from MySQL schema table counts.

capacity_headroom_rule.rule: Stress-validation success is one engineering readiness input. Production readiness additionally depends on architecture, security/privacy, integration readiness, operational observability, and approved pilot scope.

promotion_gates.description: Source and governance consistency review confirming alignment with frozen architectural invariants.

promotion_gates.description: Business, institutional partner, and platform stakeholder review confirming operational applicability.
required_inputs: Institutional profile sign-off, SLA commercial alignment

promotion_gates.description: Empirical benchmark execution demonstrating that the proposed candidate targets are realistically achievable under the defined baseline envelope.
required_inputs: Phase 1 / Phase 8 benchmark telemetry data, load-test reports

promotion_gates.description: Security and compliance review verifying that retention and telemetry policies uphold data minimization, PII restrictions, and regulatory standards.
required_inputs: Data protection impact assessment, compliance policy confirmation

promotion_gates.description: Verification that no outstanding architectural blocker (e.g., BLK-01 MySQL performance, D-EXT-01 IdP selection, D-EXT-02 Calendar provider selection) invalidates the metric.
required_inputs: Closure of BLK-01, D-EXT-01, and D-EXT-02

promotion_gates.description: Promotion from APPROVED_ENGINEERING_BASELINE to contractual customer SLA, which requires explicit formal legal/commercial agreement.
